newsitem.title: UK: Northwest Europe oil, gas rigs rise in week.
newsitem.headline: Northwest Europe oil, gas rigs rise in week.

text.p: The number of active oil and gas rigs in operation offshore northwest Europe rose by eight to 60 in the week to October 9, consultants Arthur Andersen said.
The Norwegian sector rose by three to 15 rigs active, while the U.K. sector was up four at 31 and the Dutch sector was up one at eight rigs.
Denmark was unchanged at four rigs while Irish activity was unchanged at one.
Onshore drilling activity was down one rig at five, four in the U.K. and one in the Faroe Islands.
